title: The Voluptuous Apocalypse

sourceEvidence.excerpt: relief is not preference. A person can experience relief at the cancellation of tomorrow's obligations while still preferring that the catastrophe never occur. Human emotions are not ballots. They can register the disappearance of one burden without endorsing the mechanism that removed it. The same person who would work desperately to prevent a blackout can still notice, in the fictional blackout, the pleasure of a world in which the inbox has lost its jurisdiction. This distinction matters
